```{r import packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

`generate_data` can generate distribution in specific parameters.

```{r generate_data}
generate_data <- function(parameters){ 
  #parameters=list(dist_type,size,par1,par2,kernal,summary)
  # Hard coded standard normal distribution
  rdist<-get(paste0('r',parameters[1]))
  dist<-rdist(parameters[[2]],parameters[[3]],parameters[[4]])
  suma<-get(parameters[[6]])
  parameter_interest<-suma(dist)
  kernal<-parameters[[5]]
  return(list(dist=dist,kernal=kernal,parameter_interest=parameter_interest,suma=suma,true_par1=parameters[[3]],true_par2=parameters[[4]],rfunction=rdist))
}

```


```{r}
est_mm<-function(parameters){
  #parameters=list(dist=dist,kernal=kernal,parameter_interest=parameter_interest,suma=suma,true_par1,true_par2,rfunction)
  dist<-parameters$dist
  kernal<-parameters$kernal
  rfunction<-parameters$rfunction
  suma<-parameters$suma
  if (kernal=='gamma'){
    rate=mean(dist)/var(dist)
    shape=mean(dist)*rate
    
    #to make sure that shape>0 and rate >0
    while (mean(dist)<=0){
      dist<-rfunction(length(dist),parameters$true_par1,parameters$true_par2)
      rate=mean(dist)/var(dist)
      shape=mean(dist)*rate
    }
    return(list(kernal=kernal,size=length(dist),par1=shape,par2=rate,parameter_interest=suma(dist),suma=parameters$suma))
  }
  if (kernal=='norm'){
    mean=mean(dist)
    sd=sd(dist)
    return(list(kernal=kernal,size=length(dist),par1=mean,par2=sd,parameter_interest=parameters$parameter_interest,suma=parameters$suma))
  }
}
```

```{r construct_ci}
construct_ci <- function(parameters){
  #parametrs=list(kernal,size,par1,par2,parameter_interest,suma)
  rdist<-get(paste0('r',parameters$kernal))
  # Hard coded number of draws
  R <- 5000
  sm <- parameters$suma
  sampdist <- rep(NA, R)
  for(i in 1:R){
    b <-rdist(parameters$size,parameters$par1,parameters$par2) 
    sampdist[i] <- sm(b)
  }
  # Hard coded symmetric density interval
  list(q1=quantile(sampdist, 0.025),q2=quantile(sampdist, 0.975),parameter_interest=parameters$parameter_interest)
}
```

```{r capture_pinterestr}
capture_pinterest<-function(parameters){
  #parametrs=list(q1,q2,parameter_interest)
  cap<-1*((parameters$q1<=parameters$parameter_interest)&(parameters$q2>=parameters$parameter_interest))
  list(q1=parameters$q1,q2=parameters$q2,capture=cap)
}
```




```{r}
gamma_settings <- expand.grid(dist_type='gamma'
                    ,size=201
                    ,shape= 1.4
                    , rate = 1/3
                    , kernal=c('gamma','norm')
                    , summary = c('median','min')
                    ,stringsAsFactors = F
)
norm_settings <- expand.grid(dist_type='norm'
                    ,size=201
                    ,mean=0
                    , sd=1
                    , kernal=c('gamma','norm')
                    , summary = c('median','min')
                    ,stringsAsFactors = F
)

```

```{r}
set.seed(35)
gamma_settings[4,] %>% generate_data() %>% est_mm() %>% construct_ci() %>% capture_pinterest()
norm_settings[1,] %>% generate_data() %>% est_mm() %>% construct_ci() %>% capture_pinterest()
```

```{r}
bootstrap_cap<-function(parameters){
  dist_type<-parameters$dist_type
  size<-parameters$size
  summary<-parameters$summary
  rfunction<-get(paste0('r',dist_type))
  R<-5000
  sm<-get(summary)
  sampdist <- rep(NA, R)
  for(i in 1:R){
    b <-sample(dist_sample,length(dist_sample),replace = T)
    sampdist[i] <- sm(b)
  }
  q1<-quantile(sampdist,0.025)
  q2<-quantile(sampdist,0.975)
  cap<-1*(q1<=sm(dist_sample)&q2>=sm(dist_sample))
  list(q1=q1,q2=q2,capture=cap)
  cap
}


x<-rep(NA,1000)
for (i in 1:1000){
```
